# 20% discount in the Nuka Knights Merchandising Shop until April 17, 2025

Our merchandising shop offers you a big discount campaign:

**20% OFF until April 17th, 2025**

The Merchandising Shop is another channel to **support** us and to **donate** in this form. In return you get cool shirts, sweaters, mugs and much more with a funny (perhaps ironic) saying or the Nuka Knights logo. If you have ideas for other sayings and motifs, please write in the comments.
